name: data-customize
title: DataCustomize
description: Trigger and menu that shows, hides and optionally reorders the data points a view renders.

intent.summary: Trigger and menu that shows, hides and optionally reorders the data points a view renders.
useWhen: A card list, map overlay or other non-table view lets the viewer choose which data points appear.
A toolbar needs Customize as a peer of Filter, Sort and Group rather than a tab inside Preferences.
avoidWhen: The view is a ds-table. Table owns its column customizer through columnCustomizer, which locks the last visible column and reorders columns.

alternatives.when: The choice is one submitted form value.
alternatives.reason: Select owns form-value and listbox semantics, not table sort state.

accessibility: The trigger and menu share one accessible name; pass aria-label when Customize is ambiguous on the page.
Rows are switches, so each one announces its own checked state.
states: reorderable is off by default, so rows are switches with no drag handle. Turn it on only where a display order exists.
minVisible is zero by default, so every field may be hidden. Raise it when the view needs a data point to stay visible.
catalogHeader labels the field rows; it is omitted unless options supply a second section, in which case it defaults to Data.
options render as their own Options section and emit dsOptionChange rather than a field config change.
dsFieldsConfigChange emits hiddenFieldIds and fieldOrder together, so a consumer that never reorders can ignore fieldOrder.
responsiveBehavior: The trigger collapses to its icon when the toolbar runs out of room, matching the other data controls.

customElements: Assign columns and sort as JavaScript properties. Replace sort from both dsSortChange on this control and dsSortChange on the table.
react: Keep one sort state and pass it to both ds-table and ds-data-sort; update it from either event.
angular: Import the generated DsTableSort adapter, bind columns and sort, and handle dsSortChange with the same owner that handles table header sorting.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the trigger and menu.

catalogHeader.description: Section header above the catalog rows. Omitted when there is no second section.

fieldOrder.description: Controlled display order. Ids missing from it keep catalog order.

fields.description: Catalog of data points the view can render.

label.description: Visible trigger label. Collapses to the icon when space is tight.

minVisible.description:
Fields that must stay visible. Zero by default, so a view whose identity
lives outside this catalog can hide every entry in it.

options.description: Extra switch rows rendered in their own Options section.

reorderable.description:
Drag-reorder the catalog rows. Off by default: most surfaces only show and
hide, and a card layout has no column order to express.

peerDependencies.frameworks: Custom Elements; React 18/19 wrappers; Vue 3 wrappers; Angular 19-22 standalone adapters.
